warnings.message: pnpm: allowBuilds takes package names only; "@scope/*" not written
warnings.fix: List the package names in installScripts.allow

warnings.message: pnpm: blockExoticSubdeps stops git and tarball sources only for indirect dependencies; direct ones stay allowed
warnings.fix: Run depcurfew doctor, which reports direct ones in pnpm-lock.yaml

warnings.message: pnpm: minimumReleaseAge: 10080 in pnpm-workspace.yaml (line 5) waits 1 week, longer than cooldown.minimum "3d" in depcurfew.json; depcurfew apply replaces it with 4320, so pnpm waits only 3 days
warnings.fix: To keep the longer delay, set cooldown.minimum to "7d" in depcurfew.json and run depcurfew apply again

warnings.message: Renovate: minimumReleaseAge: "7 days" in renovate.json (line 3) waits 1 week, longer than cooldown.minimum "3d" in depcurfew.json; depcurfew apply replaces it with "3 days", so Renovate waits only 3 days
warnings.fix: To keep the longer delay, set cooldown.minimum to "7d" in depcurfew.json and run depcurfew apply again; if an earlier depcurfew apply wrote this value to renovate.json and you lowered cooldown.minimum on purpose, nothing to do
